subject.title: fix: fall back after replay-safe Bedrock prompt aborts

question: May this PR merge on source-level coverage plus negative Bedrock live attempts, or is a real provider-abort-to-fallback trace required first?
rationale: Only a maintainer can accept the residual production-evidence risk because the reporter’s abort envelope was not reproduced in the contributor’s AWS environment.

options.title: Require the targeted trace
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted after-fix Bedrock log shows the replay-safe provider abort, configured fallback attempt, and successful completion.

options.title: Override the proof gap
options.body: Accept the focused source tests and negative live Bedrock attempts as sufficient for this narrow replay-safe failover extension.

recommendation.title: Require the targeted trace
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted after-fix Bedrock log shows the replay-safe provider abort, configured fallback attempt, and successful completion.
